name: Leprosy
overview: Scripture presents leprosy as a serious condition requiring careful examination and regulation by the priesthood, as seen in Leviticus 13 where the priest observes the progression of the disease over several days to determine cleanliness or uncleanness. The law mandates isolation for those afflicted, reflecting both the physical and ceremonial implications of the disease. This divine instruction underscores the holiness God requires from His people, illustrating how leprosy was both a physical malady and a symbol of separation from the community until cleansing was confirmed.
